scope: Paris administrative city. Unverified candidates do not become confirmed Paris venues.
limitations: This is a varied verification batch, not full coverage or a complete operating-status audit.
Current official web listings support operating-as-listed status; no physical visit or telephone confirmation was performed.
OSM-derived coordinates are location corroboration, not independent evidence of current operation.
Opening hours are Europe/Paris local time and may change on holidays or event days.
All price fields stay null: no sufficiently dated menu with currency and serving size was verified.
No public Telegram source was used in this bounded batch.

Original JSON was later available from supplied source. All 2,339 candidate positions now have official commune polygon checks in separate audit; within 100m of edge remains review. Do not confuse that with full operating-status verification.

boundary_audit_summary.method: WGS84 point-in-polygon, holes supported. Official Geo API Paris commune 75056 contour includes both woods. Points within 100m of the boundary are held for address or finer-boundary review; distance is approximate local equirectangular. For ways this tests supplied representative point, not the entire footprint.
limits: Boundary membership validates location only, not present business operation or bar eligibility.
Coordinate errors, polygon generalization, and sites straddling borders require review; 100m band is conservative triage, not a claim of stated source precision.
